traits.name: Low-Light Vision
traits.summary: See twice as far as a human in dim light.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.summary: Gain a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.

traits.name: Bonus Feat
traits.summary: Gain one additional feat at 1st level.

traits.name: Seasoned
traits.summary: Choose Summerborn or Winterborn environmental adaptation; Transitional Triaxians do not gain this benefit. In severe heat or cold, attempt Fortitude saves once per hour instead of once every 10 minutes.
